0022600152.text: The San Antonio Spurs (3-2, on a three-game winning streak and 1-2 at home) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (3-2, with two straight losses) in the Spurs' sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with San Antonio sitting 6th in the West and Minnesota 8th. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Spurs lost 1-2 to Minnesota in the 2025-26 regular season and then won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-2, including a 139-109 win in Minneapolis on May 15. Currently out for San Antonio are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and out for Minnesota are Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery).
